ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: preference_logsigmoid_costgap_weighted_diff_repaired
ir.intuition: Fixed failure due to missing 'cost_gap' key by replacing 'cost_gap' with 'delta_rank', which is guaranteed present and a valid quality signal. The loss scales the weighted log probability difference inversely by absolute delta_rank plus epsilon, preserving the original idea of emphasizing pairs with larger quality gaps. This ensures gate compliance and retains intended signal weighting.
ir.pseudocode:
alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", 1.0))
log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
weight = batch["weight"]
delta_rank = batch["delta_rank"]
abs_delta_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
scale = alpha / (abs_delta_rank + 1e-6)
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
weighted_diff = weight * diff * scale
preference_score = ops.logsigmoid(weighted_diff)
loss = -preference_score
return ops.mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    alpha = float(extra.get("alpha", 1.0))
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    delta_rank = batch["delta_rank"]
    abs_delta_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    scale = alpha / (ops.add(abs_delta_rank, eps))
    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    weighted_diff = ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(diff, scale))
    preference = ops.logsigmoid(weighted_diff)
    loss = ops.neg(preference)
    return ops.mean(loss)
